lines.text: Everything in PongLens starts with a match video. This is the Upload tab.
Not sure how to film it? How to record shows you the camera angle that works best.
Pick a video from your phone. MP4 or M O V, up to two gigabytes. The upload starts as soon as you choose it.
No file to hand? Paste a YouTube link and PongLens imports the match from there.
While it processes, fill in who you played, where, and what kind of match it was.
You get an email when the match is ready.
